annotations.title: Remove a book from my library

description: Take a book off the signed-in reader's shelves entirely, discarding its shelf, progress and notes. The reader's rating for the book stays. Suits "take X off my shelves" and "remove X from my list". Moving a book between shelves is add_to_library with a new readingStatus. Needs a linked Siftivo account.
name: remove_from_library
title: Remove a book from my library
